The worker appears stuck in a wait state with a heartbeat age of 13.6, but config and payments both look fine. Since restarting should be safe given the healthy config, I'll quickly check the worker logs and then proceed with a restart to mitigate the issue.
The worker is stuck. The queue depth is 59 and only 13 orders have been processed. The config looks healthy, so restarting the worker is safe.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: The order worker thread was stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper reason it stalled is unknown.
evidence: Before the restart: orders_created 72, processed 13, queue_depth 59, worker_heartbeat_age_s 13.6
DEBUG log: worker entered wait state
Config was sane and recent_changes showed nothing relevant (v1.3 was deployed 26.7h ago)
After restart: processed 98 of 98, queue_depth 0, heartbeat age 0.1s, check_invariants green
args.impact: 59 orders were stuck in the queue and unprocessed. They were worth 36743.02 SAR in total (10108.83 SAR plus 7102.45 USD), as reported by get_business_metrics. All of them were processed with payment after the restart. No orders were dropped, none were left unpaid, and there were no ledger issues.
recommended_actions: Add an alert on worker heartbeat age and queue depth.
Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and stops consuming the queue.
args.summary: The worker thread stalled, so the queue backed up to 59 orders while /health stayed green. I restarted the worker and it drained the queue. All 98 orders now have payments, and the invariants are green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown.
